description: This file defines an abstract class AbstractCalendarProvider which serves as a base for implementing calendar provider integrations. It includes method signatures for connection testing, event retrieval, creation, updating, and deletion, along with utility methods for handling event IDs and synchronization timestamps.

classes.name: AbstractCalendarProvider
classes.description: An abstract class that provides a template for calendar provider implementations, including methods for connecting, testing, CRUD operations on calendar events, and configuration handling.

methods.name: setConnection
methods.description: Sets the calendar account connection object.

methods.name: testCalendarConnection
methods.description: Abstract method to test the calendar connection, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: getEvents
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve calendar events based on a query.

methods.name: createEventFromSource
methods.description: Creates a new calendar event in the target system based on a source event and sync time.

methods.name: generateEventId
methods.description: Generates a unique ID for calendar events.

methods.name: createEvent
methods.description: Creates an event in the calendar provider with a given target event object.

methods.name: doCreateEvent
methods.description: Abstract method for performing the actual creation of an event, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: getEvent
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve an event by its target ID.

methods.name: updateEventFromSource
methods.description: Updates an existing calendar event based on source event data and sync time.

methods.name: updateEvent
methods.description: Updates an event with specified sync time.

methods.name: doUpdateEvent
methods.description: Abstract method for performing the actual update, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: updateSourceEvent
methods.description: Updates the source event with linked target ID after synchronization.

methods.name: deleteEvent
methods.description: Template method to delete an event by target ID, invokes provider-specific deletion.

methods.name: doDeleteEvent
methods.description: Abstract method to perform event deletion, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: getExternalCalendarName
methods.description: Retrieves external calendar name from configuration.
